expectedUsable: The email field's accessible name matches its visible label ("Email address"), so a screen-reader user and a sighted user are filling in the same field.

violations.expectedFix: Remove the contradictory aria-label="Phone number" so the accessible name falls back to the visible <label> "Email address" (or make aria-label match the label).
violations.notes: The <label> is correctly associated (axe's label rule passes) but aria-label overrides the accessible name to "Phone number", contradicting the visible text. Because the applicable element is a text input, axe's label-content-name-mismatch (2.5.3) does not fire — Layer B surfaces the name/visible-text divergence and Layer C judges the contradiction.
